data.define: Used when something makes you laugh a lot.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm weak' when you're really ill.
misuse.why: People may think you are unwell.

publish.title: What does "I'm weak" mean?
publish.value: I'm weak = That's so funny. Example: "That meme? I'm weak!" (very casual English, US).
